subject: prog-cont
title: PROG.CONT.------EXP.DY.
description: Diagram in EXT.F(II)-14, on the page where Braxton describes the move of post-Ayler musicians from Europe back to America, after the Paris cycle that solidified post-Ayler creativity as a transition-grade thrust. PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) is crossed with EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics). The diagram contains both (P)CULT-SOLD (the point of idea completion of culture solidification) and (C)AFL (the concept of affinity alignment) and (R)TM (the reality of terminology—or terms of a definition) — three explicitly prefixed nodes, marking that culture solidification, affinity alignment, and terminology are operating at distinct prefix-levels. PROG-CONT → EXP-DYM is the crossing. SOC-RT (social reality) branches from the subject's line and opens into TRS (transition). TRS opens into COS-D (cosmic dictates) → PHY-U-P (physical universe particular), into T-C-IMP (time continuum implications), and into (P)CULT-SOLD; (P)CULT-SOLD opens into PRI-INFO (principle information) and (R)TM, and (R)TM opens into (C)AFL.
